analysis.moatAndBusiness: GE Vernova operates in the global energy sector, providing critical power generation and electrification equipment. Its economic moat is built on proprietary technology, a massive installed base, and long-term service contracts that generate recurring revenue. The company profits from both the initial sale of large-scale energy hardware and the subsequent high-margin maintenance and support services.
